svg.text: From points to a bare-earth DTM
Every point gets a label, and only the ground points build the terrain model. Where cover was dense, the surface between them is interpolated and less certain.
a slice through the cloud: canopy,
a roof, a parked car, the ground
a filter sorts them by shape:
the lowest smooth surface is ground
grid it: one height per cell, the
ticks; the trees and roof are gone
Software does the sorting with filters such as a cloth simulation filter. Check its answer where the cover was dense or the ground steep.
